citations.title: IDF completed clearing of Hezbollah underground infrastructure in the Ali al-Taher Ridge
citations.excerpt: The IDF completed the clearing of Hezbollah’s underground infrastructure in the Ali al-Taher Ridge area and is operating to neutralize it. The terrorists who were present inside the infrastructure carried out terror attacks against Israel and IDF soldiers and were eliminated or fled the area. The infrastructure is a strategic underground network that was built over 2 decades and funded and planned by the Iranian terror regime, containing command centers, weapons, living quarters and more. The operation to neutralize the underground infrastructure sites is still ongoing; upon completion, the IDF will adjust its defensive posture in accordance with the situational assessment.

citations.title: IDF says it entered, cleared Hezbollah’s Ali Taher Ridge tunnels ahead of demolition
citations.excerpt: The Israel Defense Forces said Thursday night that it had finished clearing a strategic underground facility belonging to the Hezbollah terror group beneath a mountainous ridge in southern Lebanon in recent weeks. According to the IDF, troops of the 36th Division achieved operational control of the ridge area above and below ground and cleared two major tunnel routes under Ali Taher of Hezbollah operatives, killing some of them while others fled. The IDF described the facility as strategic infrastructure that was built over two decades and financed and planned by Iran. Following the activity, the ability to carry out terror attacks against Israeli civilians and IDF troops from the infrastructure has been neutralized. Despite a Reuters report claiming Israel had put off storming Ali Taher and that IRGC members were inside, the military said troops had been operating inside the tunnels for several weeks and indicated no IRGC members were inside when the routes were captured. Israeli forces continue to operate inside a self-declared security zone which runs around 10 kilometers deep inside Lebanese territory.

citations.title: Iran warns US against Israeli attack on south Lebanon ridge held by Hezbollah, sources say
citations.excerpt: Iran has warned the United States that it would respond forcefully to an Israeli offensive on a mountainous ridge in southern Lebanon where Iranian military personnel are holed up alongside Hezbollah fighters, three officials briefed on the message told Reuters. Two regional officials said over a dozen members of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, including at least two senior officers, were with Hezbollah fighters. A third source said the message was delivered around mid-August and that as a result of U.S. pressure, Israel had put off storming Ali al-Taher. A White House official said this is not accurate. Reuters could not independently confirm the military situation at Ali al-Taher. Maariv, citing a military source, said the Israeli military assessed there were no IRGC forces in Ali al-Taher.

citations.title: ELIMINATED: 2 terrorists who crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza
citations.excerpt: ELIMINATED: 2 terrorists who crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza and approached IDF troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat. The terrorists were eliminated in order to remove the threat they posed. The IDF said the two crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza and approached troops in a way that created an immediate threat requiring an immediate response to protect the force operating in the area.

citations.title: CEASEFIRE VIOLATION: A terrorist crossed the Yellow Line
citations.excerpt: CEASEFIRE VIOLATION: A terrorist crossed the Yellow Line and approached IDF troops operating in the area, in a manner that posed an immediate threat. In response, the terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed. The IDF presented the incident as a ceasefire violation in Gaza after a terrorist crossed the Yellow Line and approached troops.

citations.title: Prime Minister Netanyahu Rosh Hashanah toast at the Kirya
citations.excerpt: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held today a Rosh Hashanah toast together with Defense Minister Israel Katz, IDF Chief of the General Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, and members of the IDF General Staff Forum at the Kirya in Tel Aviv. Netanyahu said Israel faced the threat of annihilation by a regime that aspires to eradicate us and wants to arm itself with nuclear bombs to destroy us. He said this regime is currently faltering and weaker than ever before, and that the central mission still before us is to topple this regime. He added: I say to our enemies, do not mess with us. If you have learned anything, do not mess with us.

citations.title: Iran has warned US it will respond forcefully to any Israeli offensive on south Lebanon ridge
citations.excerpt: Defense Minister Israel Katz said an Iranian attack on Israel would free the IDF from all constraints, and that in such a scenario the military would strike all infrastructure, including energy infrastructure, and return Iran to the Stone Age and darkness. Katz said there are signs that heavy economic pressure on Iran and fear of an uprising and the fall of the regime could push them to desperate measures. He added that Israel is well prepared, defensively and offensively, for every possibility, and the IDF is ready to carry out the mission.

dailyBrief.title: IDF clears Ali al-Taher tunnels as Gaza Yellow Line fire continues
dailyBrief.summary: The IDF said it finished clearing Hezbollah underground infrastructure under Ali al-Taher Ridge and is working to neutralize the site, while reporting Yellow Line crossings in northern Gaza. Netanyahu and Katz warned Iran against attacking Israel. Reuters same-day claims that Israel had put off storming the ridge remain disputed.

passages.text: The security picture combined a completed IDF clearance of Hezbollah’s Ali al-Taher underground complex in the southern Lebanon buffer zone with Yellow Line crossings in northern Gaza. Official Israeli statements presented both as responses to immediate threats.

The IDF said the 36th Division achieved operational control above and below ground at Ali al-Taher, cleared two major tunnel routes, and is working to neutralize a complex built over two decades with Iranian planning and funding.
In Gaza the IDF reported a morning Yellow Line crossing labeled a ceasefire violation and a later incident in which 2 terrorists crossed the Yellow Line and were eliminated.

The IDF said terrorists inside the Ali al-Taher infrastructure had attacked Israel and IDF soldiers, that the ability to attack from the site has been neutralized, and that after neutralization the army will adjust its defensive posture. Netanyahu said do not mess with us. Katz said an Iranian attack would free the IDF from all constraints, including strikes on energy infrastructure.

Reuters reported that Iran warned the United States a full Israeli offensive on Ali al-Taher would meet a large-scale Iranian attack. A White House official told Reuters the characterization of the message or of U.S. pressure on Israel was not accurate.

Watch whether neutralization at Ali al-Taher draws an Iranian or Hezbollah response, whether any verified evidence appears for the Reuters IRGC-presence claim, and whether Yellow Line incidents in northern Gaza remain limited force-protection engagements.

claims.title: Reuters IRGC and postponed-storm claims remain unverified
claims.text: Reuters attributed to anonymous officials a claim that over a dozen IRGC members were with Hezbollah at Ali al-Taher and that Israel had put off storming the ridge after an Iranian warning. Reuters could not independently confirm the military situation. A White House official said this is not accurate.

citationLinks.rationale: Originating account, including the verification limit.

claims.title: IDF clearance contradicts the postponed-assault storyline
claims.text: The IDF said it completed clearing the underground infrastructure after weeks of operations. Times of Israel notes that timeline undercuts the claim Israel had put off storming the ridge.
claims.attributedTo: Israel Defense Forces as reported by The Times of Israel
claims.uncertainty: Absence of reported IRGC captives is not complete proof no IRGC member was ever present.

citationLinks.rationale: Contrasts Reuters postponed-storm claim with the IDF timeline.

passages.text: The exportable frame was a Reuters account of an Iranian warning, an alleged IRGC presence of over a dozen men, and a claim that Israel had put off storming Ali al-Taher. Reuters could not independently confirm the ridge, and a White House official rejected the pressure characterization.

Hours later the IDF said the underground infrastructure had already been cleared after weeks of operations and that neutralization continues. Times of Israel recorded that this timeline undercuts the same-day postponed-assault story.
